### Stack
```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Load required libraries
library(data.table)

# Set the working directory to the STA497 folder
setwd("./Raw")
# if access from google drive, within "code" folder
# setwd("../data/final data/sound/Raw")

# Get a list of all LNM folders
folders <- list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize empty lists to store data for the different types of files
logged_spectra_list <- list()
total_spectra_list <- list()
logged_bb_list <- list()
total_bb_list <- list()
logged_ln_list <- list()
total_ln_list <- list()

# Initialize vectors to keep track of missing or empty files
missing_logged_spectra <- c()
missing_total_spectra <- c()
missing_logged_bb <- c()
missing_total_bb <- c()
missing_logged_ln <- c()
missing_total_ln <- c()

empty_logged_spectra <- c()
empty_total_spectra <- c()
empty_logged_bb <- c()
empty_total_bb <- c()
empty_logged_ln <- c()
empty_total_ln <- c()

# Iterate through all folders
for (folder in folders) {
  # Extract folder name
  folder_name <- basename(folder)
  
  # Construct file paths for Logged and Total files
  logged_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedSpectra.txt"))
  total_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalSpectra.txt"))
  
  logged_bb_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedBB.txt"))
  total_bb_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalBB.txt"))
  
  logged_ln_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedLN.txt"))
  total_ln_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalLN.txt"))
  
  # Check and read LoggedSpectra files
  if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) > 0) {
    logged_spectra_data <- fread(logged_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_spectra_list[[length(logged_spectra_list) + 1]] <- logged_spectra_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) == 0) {
    empty_logged_spectra <- c(empty_logged_spectra, folder_name)
  } else {
    missing_logged_spectra <- c(missing_logged_spectra, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read TotalSpectra files
  if (file.exists(total_spectra_file)) {
    if (file.size(total_spectra_file) > 0) {
      total_spectra_data <- fread(total_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
      total_spectra_list[[length(total_spectra_list) + 1]] <- total_spectra_data
    } else {
      empty_total_spectra <- c(empty_total_spectra, folder_name)
    }
  } else {
    missing_total_spectra <- c(missing_total_spectra, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read LoggedBB files
  if (file.exists(logged_bb_file) && file.size(logged_bb_file) > 0) {
    logged_bb_data <- fread(logged_bb_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_bb_list[[length(logged_bb_list) + 1]] <- logged_bb_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_bb_file) && file.size(logged_bb_file) == 0) {
    empty_logged_bb <- c(empty_logged_bb, folder_name)
  } else {
    missing_logged_bb <- c(missing_logged_bb, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read TotalBB files
  if (file.exists(total_bb_file)) {
    if (file.size(total_bb_file) > 0) {
      total_bb_data <- fread(total_bb_file, fill = TRUE)
      total_bb_list[[length(total_bb_list) + 1]] <- total_bb_data
    } else {
      empty_total_bb <- c(empty_total_bb, folder_name)
    }
  } else {
    missing_total_bb <- c(missing_total_bb, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read LoggedLN files
  if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) > 0) {
    logged_ln_data <- fread(logged_ln_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_ln_list[[length(logged_ln_list) + 1]] <- logged_ln_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) == 0) {
    empty_logged_ln <- c(empty_logged_ln, folder_name)
  } else {
    missing_logged_ln <- c(missing_logged_ln, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check and read TotalLN files
  if (file.exists(total_ln_file)) {
    if (file.size(total_ln_file) > 0) {
      total_ln_data <- fread(total_ln_file, fill = TRUE)
      total_ln_list[[length(total_ln_list) + 1]] <- total_ln_data
    } else {
      empty_total_ln <- c(empty_total_ln, folder_name)
    }
  } else {
    missing_total_ln <- c(missing_total_ln, folder_name)
  }
}

# Stack all the data for each group
if (length(logged_spectra_list) > 0) {
  logged_spectra_combined <- rbindlist(logged_spectra_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(logged_spectra_combined, file = "../009_097_logged_spectra.rdata")
}

if (length(total_spectra_list) > 0) {
  total_spectra_combined <- rbindlist(total_spectra_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(total_spectra_combined, file = "../009_097_total_spectra.rdata")
}

if (length(logged_bb_list) > 0) {
  logged_bb_combined <- rbindlist(logged_bb_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(logged_bb_combined, file = "../009_097_logged_bb.rdata")
}

if (length(total_bb_list) > 0) {
  total_bb_combined <- rbindlist(total_bb_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(total_bb_combined, file = "../009_097_total_bb.rdata")
}

if (length(logged_ln_list) > 0) {
  logged_ln_combined <- rbindlist(logged_ln_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(logged_ln_combined, file = "../009_097_logged_ln.rdata")
}

if (length(total_ln_list) > 0) {
  total_ln_combined <- rbindlist(total_ln_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(total_ln_combined, file = "../009_097_total_ln.rdata")
}

# Report missing or empty files
if (length(missing_logged_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("No logged spectra in folders:\n")
  print(missing_logged_spectra)
} else {
  cat("All folders have LoggedSpectra.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_logged_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("Empty LoggedSpectra files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_logged_spectra)
} else {
  cat("No empty LoggedSpectra files.\n")
}

if (length(missing_total_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("No total spectra in folders:\n")
  print(missing_total_spectra)
} else {
  cat("All folders have TotalSpectra.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_total_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("Empty TotalSpectra files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_total_spectra)
} else {
  cat("No empty TotalSpectra files.\n")
}

if (length(missing_logged_bb) > 0) {
  cat("No logged BB in folders:\n")
  print(missing_logged_bb)
} else {
  cat("All folders have LoggedBB.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_logged_bb) > 0) {
  cat("Empty LoggedBB files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_logged_bb)
} else {
  cat("No empty LoggedBB files.\n")
}

if (length(missing_total_bb) > 0) {
  cat("No total BB in folders:\n")
  print(missing_total_bb)
} else {
  cat("All folders have TotalBB.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_total_bb) > 0) {
  cat("Empty TotalBB files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_total_bb)
} else {
  cat("No empty TotalBB files.\n")
}

if (length(missing_logged_ln) > 0) {
  cat("No logged LN in folders:\n")
  print(missing_logged_ln)
} else {
  cat("All folders have LoggedLN.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_logged_ln) > 0) {
  cat("Empty LoggedLN files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_logged_ln)
} else {
  cat("No empty LoggedLN files.\n")
}

if (length(missing_total_ln) > 0) {
  cat("No total LN in folders:\n")
  print(missing_total_ln)
} else {
  cat("All folders have TotalLN.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_total_ln) > 0) {
  cat("Empty TotalLN files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_total_ln)
} else {
  cat("No empty TotalLN files.\n")
}

```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(data.table)

# Set the working directory to the STA497 folder
setwd("./Raw")

# Get a list of all LNM folders
folders <- list.dirs(".", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

# Initialize empty lists to store data for both LoggedSpectra and TotalSpectra
logged_spectra_list <- list()
total_spectra_list <- list()

# Initialize vectors to keep track of missing or empty files
missing_total_spectra <- c()
empty_logged_spectra <- c()
empty_total_spectra <- c()

# Iterate through all folders
for (folder in folders) {
  # Extract folder name
  folder_name <- basename(folder)
  
  # Construct file paths for LoggedSpectra.txt and TotalSpectra.txt
  logged_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_LoggedSpectra.txt"))
  total_spectra_file <- file.path(folder, paste0(folder_name, "_TotalSpectra.txt"))
  
  # Check if the LoggedSpectra.txt file exists and has a non-zero size
  if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) > 0) {
    logged_spectra_data <- fread(logged_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
    logged_spectra_list[[length(logged_spectra_list) + 1]] <- logged_spectra_data
  } else if (file.exists(logged_spectra_file) && file.size(logged_spectra_file) == 0) {
    # If the file exists but has a size of 0, record it
    empty_logged_spectra <- c(empty_logged_spectra, folder_name)
  }
  
  # Check if the TotalSpectra.txt file exists and has a non-zero size
  if (file.exists(total_spectra_file)) {
    if (file.size(total_spectra_file) > 0) {
      total_spectra_data <- fread(total_spectra_file, fill = TRUE)
      total_spectra_list[[length(total_spectra_list) + 1]] <- total_spectra_data
    } else {
      # If TotalSpectra.txt exists but is empty, record it
      empty_total_spectra <- c(empty_total_spectra, folder_name)
    }
  } else {
    # If TotalSpectra.txt is missing, append the folder name to the missing list
    missing_total_spectra <- c(missing_total_spectra, folder_name)
  }
}

# Stack all the LoggedSpectra data together
if (length(logged_spectra_list) > 0) {
  logged_spectra_combined <- rbindlist(logged_spectra_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(logged_spectra_combined, file = "../009_097_logged_spectra.rdata")
}

# Stack all the TotalSpectra data together
if (length(total_spectra_list) > 0) {
  total_spectra_combined <- rbindlist(total_spectra_list, fill = TRUE)
  save(total_spectra_combined, file = "../009_097_total_spectra.rdata")
}

# Report missing or empty files
if (length(missing_total_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("No total spectra in folders:\n")
  print(missing_total_spectra)
} else {
  cat("All folders have TotalSpectra.txt files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_logged_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("Empty LoggedSpectra files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_logged_spectra)
} else {
  cat("No empty LoggedSpectra files.\n")
}

if (length(empty_total_spectra) > 0) {
  cat("Empty TotalSpectra files in folders:\n")
  print(empty_total_spectra)
} else {
  cat("No empty TotalSpectra files.\n")
}

```

total_spectra_list <- list()

  } else if (file.exists(logged_bb_file) && file.size(logged_bb_file) == 0) {

    }
  } else {

  # Check and read LoggedLN files
  if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) > 0) {
    logged_ln_data <- fread(logged_ln_file, fill = TRUE)

  } else if (file.exists(logged_ln_file) && file.size(logged_ln_file) == 0) {
